characters.name: Acharya Vidyadhar
characters.personality: Intelligent, humorous, knowledgeable, slightly eccentric; explains rules with memorable analogies and never humiliates a learner.
characters.dialogueStyle: Calm, witty, encouraging, and crystal clear.
characters.signatureQuote: A verb is the engine of a sentence. Without it, your sentence is a parked vehicle.

visualIdentity.outfit: Modern indigo kurta-jacket with subtle woven border, round spectacles, pocket notebook

characters.name: Chikoo Bandar
characters.personality: Overconfident, playful, energetic, and frequently makes deliberate grammar mistakes for learners to fix.
characters.dialogueStyle: Dramatic claims, funny excuses, and enthusiastic misunderstandings.
characters.signatureQuote: Yesterday I eat ten bananas! I am sure my grammar is delicious!

visualIdentity.outfit: Bright saffron vest, teal scarf, small canvas satchel

characters.name: Detective Ira
characters.personality: Curious, logical, observant, and adventurous; leads mystery clues, puzzles, and error-detection challenges.
characters.dialogueStyle: Crisp clues, sharp questions, and step-by-step deductions.
characters.signatureQuote: Every misplaced word leaves a clue. Let us inspect the timeline.

visualIdentity.outfit: Mustard trench-vest over crisp teal shirt, magnifying glass, clue notepad

characters.name: Maharaj Vakya
characters.personality: Dramatic, strict about sentence discipline, theatrical, and secretly funny when sentences misbehave.
characters.dialogueStyle: Royal proclamations, exaggerated reactions, and witty courtroom verdicts.
characters.signatureQuote: Order in the court! A subject and a verb must never quarrel in my kingdom!

visualIdentity.outfit: Deep maroon achkan with subtle gold trim and a clean modern royal badge

characters.name: Vaani
characters.personality: Warm, expressive, articulate, and fascinated by word origins, idioms, and subtle nuances.
characters.dialogueStyle: Rich wordplay, vivid everyday Indian comparisons, and warm encouragement.
characters.signatureQuote: Words are like spices—choose the right one and the whole sentence comes alive.

visualIdentity.outfit: Emerald handloom stole over cream tunic, silver jhumkas, word-card fan
